title: position and coordinates saver I universal and undetected
features:
Position and coordinates saver Script
Up to 5 savable and loadable teleports

The X Y Z textbox is a typable which you put a number to the coordiantes you want to teleport.

Copy Coordinates - this copies your real time coordinates
Copy Script Coordinates - this gives you a separate script of your real time coordinates and turn it into a executable script instead of a normal one
Teleport Coordinates - This teleports the coordinates to the textbox you put.

The upper coordinates - thats your current coordinates.
Bottom Coordinates - that will be the coordinates if you want to teleport too
